items.title: The first fully Chinese desktop: Huawei launches PC with Kirin X90 and HarmonyOS
items.summary: Huawei has unveiled what it describes as the first fully Chinese-made desktop PC, powered by its 10-core Kirin X90 processor and running HarmonyOS. The Qingyun HM650 is designed for government agencies and businesses, with enterprise security features and an integrated AI assistant. It is priced at 7,199 yuan (around $1,080), with sales scheduled to begin on December 1.
